Officer's narrative
On arrival at the intersection in Baytown, Texas, I found a rear-end collision involving two vehicles. Driver 2 was
stopped in the travel lane when the vehicle that Driver 1 had been associated with struck the rear of that car. Driver 1
is named on the policy covering the vehicle involved. Driver 1 later reported back strain, wihch is a plausible injury for
an impact of this kind. The damage to the rear of the struck vehicle is consistent with the force described, and the
photographs taken at the scene show the same pattern. Driver 2, a Passenger, and two independent witnesses each
described the collision the same way, and their accounts match the physical evidence. Both witnesses and I observed
that Driver 1 was not inside the vehicle at the moment of impact. No earlier damage to the vehicle was known to
anyone at the scene, and nothing observed suggested a different sequence of events. I have documented the
positions of both vehicles, the photographs, and the witness contact details in my supplemental report.
</page>
